Aleppo chaos | Shells hit jarablus outskirts leaving injuries of displaced civilians

Aleppo province: SOHR activists have documented the injury of two displaced in children and a civilian from Homs, after shells hit jrablus outskirts in Aleppo countryside in ” Euphrates Shild” area.

According to SOHR sources, the shells were fired from areas holding regime forces and forces of the SDF-backed Military Council in eastern Aleppo countryside.

Since the early hours of Saturday morning, Syrian Observatory activists reported that clashes erupted between Turkish-backed National Army factions and military forces operating in the area, on Al-Hawshriya and Al-Jat frontlines north of Manbij, in the northeastern countryside of Aleppo, with heavy machine-guns. No casualties were reported.
